lines.trans: Have you completely lost your mind?
Why are you stealing our vinegar?
Its expiration date will end soon!
And at home my children want to eat.
Of course, the children at home really ask for vinegar!
I just took a little for salad.
The chef will see and tear off your hands!
Fedya, don't tell the chef anything, please!
The chef is just leaving for the market now.
Great, that means we have a little time.
The chef will return, and everything must be ready!
Let's quickly start cutting the meat together.
Put the bottle back in place and take a knife.
That is all, I am working and not stealing anymore!
